description: Minimal IPC allowlist (least privilege — see docs/security/tauri-ipc-boundary.md). App-defined commands (pairing, signing) are allowed by default from the local webview and need no permission here. The frontend's only core need is the event system: it listens for the `notification_route` event the iOS tap handler emits (an operator alert deep-linking into a server's Accounts screen). Deliberately does NOT grant `core:default` — that blanket set bundles window/menu/tray/path/etc. this frontend never touches.
